home.signedOutBody: This site is for students who have already been in touch with a coach. Sign in with Google to book a lesson.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Sign in with Google. We only read your email address and name.
signIn.unavailable: Google sign-in is not configured yet. Please contact the administrator.
signIn.reasonSessionInvalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
signIn.reasonExpired: For security, sessions are re-verified every 7 days.

booking.handoverNote: The first 10 minutes of each booking are the coach's handover from the previous student: the lesson starts at ten past and runs to the hour, 10 minutes shorter than the booked block, so each booking carries a handover credit.
booking.noSlots: No times available on this day.
booking.offSeason: The season runs 1 December to 1 May. This date is outside it.
booking.otherTimes: Want a different time? Message the coach on WeChat at {wechat}.
booking.slotTaken: Sorry — someone just took that slot. Please pick another time.
booking.holdCountdown: Finish signing and payment within {minutes} minutes or the slot is released.
booking.matchTitle: Not sure who to pick? Let us match you
booking.matchBody: Tell us how you ski and we'll put you with a coach who teaches that level and has the lighter schedule. You can still change later.

waiver.title: Liability waiver
waiver.seasonNote: Signed once per coach per season. Later bookings with the same coach this season will not ask again.
waiver.reusedFrom: Covered by the waiver signed on {date}
waiver.mustScroll: Please read to the end before signing
waiver.consentElectronic: I agree to sign this agreement electronically
waiver.minorNotice: This participant is under 18, so a parent or legal guardian must sign. Please note: in Ontario, a guardian's signature generally does not prevent the child themselves from bringing a claim later.
waiver.adultOnly: Adult participants must sign for themselves; nobody can sign on their behalf.

payment.title: Payment
payment.redactNote: Please cover your balance and any details you do not want shared. Only your coach can see this screenshot.
payment.awaitingReview: We have your screenshot. Your booking is confirmed once the coach checks it.
payment.rejected: The coach did not accept this payment. Reason: {reason}. Please upload again.

participants.title: Participants
participants.adultNotSelf: Adult students must book and sign with their own Google account, so they cannot be added here.
participants.duplicate: A participant with that name and date of birth already exists.

coach.title: Coach area
coach.icsHelp: In Google Calendar choose 'Other calendars → From URL' and paste this address to sync every lesson automatically. Keep it private.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
